title: Review, with a first-time note
note: The letter on a sheet with its header, "TO ASHA · MONTH N" and "FROM MAMA", each small fix marked in the words, in the letter's own face (taken-out words struck through, a name spelled your way shown after the word heard), the fixes behind one row (open from the start while a screen reader is on, which the web build always reports), and the registered one-time note. No reassurance line under the title (S17). Words come from the seeded fictional family Asha (the web build has no speech model, so a real recording never gets words).
text: Hear it Close Read it back Please have a read Got it We take out small slips, like an um or a repeat, and mark each one. Tap a mark to see it and put it back. We can mishear a name, so please read it before you save. To Asha · Month 7 From Mama Asha, um, today you you held the spoon by yourself. You mostly painted your face with it, but you were so so proud. I want you to know that I was too. With small fixes Exactly as said 2 small fixes Took out a sound um, Add to Asha's book Keep private
